items.title: Four questions every tool should answer (even Figma) about AI training and model usage
items.excerpt: Patrick Neeman argues Figma's class action isn't really about copyright — it's about defaults, and defaults are a design decision. He lays out four questions every design tool (Figma included) should answer about how it uses your work to train AI models.

items.title: Hate generative AI? Maybe it's time to boycott Netflix
items.excerpt: With Netflix leaning into generative AI across production, Creative Bloq argues creatives angry about AI's encroachment should vote with their subscriptions — a look at how a major studio's gen-AI adoption reshapes the creative industry.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5 for both AI coding and general office work
items.excerpt: Anthropic's new frontier model Claude Opus 5 is a cheaper, stronger model for coding and agents — the class of model that now powers AI design tools like Claude Design, Cursor, Lovable and Figma Make, so its release ripples directly into designers' AI workflows.
